data.title: ASA Gold and Precious Metals Limited Announces Distribution Declaration
data.description: ASA Gold and Precious Metals Limited (NYSE: ASA) in Portland, Maine, announced a distribution of $0.05 per common share, payable on November 12, 2026 to shareholders of record as of November 5, 2026. The company cautions against tying investment performance to the distribution amount, as future distributions may vary.

data.title: Kopin to Host Live YouTube "Ask Me Anything" Panel from Nasdaq MarketSite on the Future of AI Infrastructure
data.description: A company based in Westborough, Massachusetts, will host a live YouTube event titled "Ask Me Anything" at Nasdaq MarketSite. The discussion will focus on the future of AI infrastructure. This event aims to bring together experts and enthusiasts to delve into critical topics related to AI's development and growth. The event will be broadcast on YouTube to reach a wider audience and encourage engagement. This initiative reflects the growing interest and importance of AI technology in various sectors. The event is scheduled to take place at Nasdaq MarketSite, providing a prestigious backdrop for the discussion.

data.title: Power Integrations Reports Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: In San Jose, California, Power Integrations (Nasdaq: POWI) disclosed that on October 15, 2026, they awarded a combined 25,325 RSUs and 1,339 PSUs to 12 employees who joined the company in September 2026. These grants were provided under Power Integrations’ Amended and Restated 2025 Inducement Award Plan. The RSUs will vest quarterly over the course of the coming four years.

data.title: Bloom Energy Supports Central Texas First Responders Ahead of Florida-Texas Matchup
data.description: Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) extended its collaboration with ESPN Radio’s College Football Campus Tour in Austin, Texas, by visiting Austin Fire Department Station #3. Before the Florida-Texas game, Bloom presented a $10,000 contribution to the Central Texas Public Safety Commission, a nonprofit aiding police, fire, and EMS departments in Central Texas. The organization has assisted these departments for over 25 years.

data.title: Sensient Announces Conference Call
data.description: Sensient Technologies Corporation, listed on NYSE as SXT, is scheduled to host an earnings call and webcast to discuss their third-quarter results for 2026 at 8:30 a.m. CDT on Friday, October 30, 2026. data.title: Bloom Energy Honors Gainesville Firefighters Who Prepare for the Moments That Matter
data.description: In San Jose, California, Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) recently acknowledged Gainesville firefighters for their proactive efforts before emergency situations occur. As a gesture of appreciation, Bloom visited Gainesville Fire Rescue Station 1 and contributed a generous $10,000 donation to Gainesville Professional Firefighters. This organization plays a vital role in assisting the firefighters and families involved in emergency responses in Gainesville. The visit and donation were part of Bloom's ongoing collaboration with ESPN Radio's partnership throughout the season.

data.title: Tesla Energy Chief Reportedly Out; AI Pivot Kicks In
data.description: Mike Snyder, the head of Tesla Energy, has reportedly resigned from his position. This change in leadership comes as Elon Musk shifts the company's focus towards artificial intelligence, prioritizing this over Tesla's previous emphasis on sustainable energy. The move signifies a strategic pivot within Tesla, as Musk steers the company in a new direction. The latest development has garnered attention from investors and industry observers alike.
